title: Old cross-room Arena DO tournament (queue → active → complete)
oneLine: Retired Arena Durable Object's queue and bracket; unrouted since gladiator.js took /api/arena, kept for its binding.
topConcern: If ever re-routed, POST /result trusts any client-claimed winner and the entry fee is client-side.

title: Duel machine (challenge → accept → active → resolved), with wager escrow and away clocks
oneLine: A two-player duel: challenge, accept with escrowed wagers, active with 15 s away clocks, resolved by kill, forfeit or clock.
topConcern: Walking into another zone never ends a duel: 10 minutes with no HP regen, fight-locked bag, and a hider wins the wager on hp fraction.

title: Gladiator arena bracket (gathering → running → complete → cleared)
oneLine: The room's one tournament: a 60 s gather, rounds of wager-0 arena duels, a crowned champion, then cleared.
topConcern: ps._arenaMatch is lost on any reconnect, so a fighter who drops and returns can eat fish and heals mid-match.

title: Arena sponsorship stake (escrowed → settled pool | swept refund)
oneLine: A spectator's stake on one arena match: escrowed at placement, settled as a pool off the server-observed winner.
topConcern: Debit and stamp commit before the arena_stake record is written; a restart between them loses the gold with no record to refund.

title: Sparring session and its clones as fake players
oneLine: An admin test spar: up to three AI clones living as playerState entries, cleared on leave, zone change or switch.
topConcern: Clones are socketless playerState entries; every playerState walker must skip _spar itself (14+ checks in 10 files), so a new walker can miss it.

title: Spar clone AI behaviour loop
oneLine: One clone's step: idle or engaged, rolling, lunging, shielding, swinging, shooting, knocked down and standing back.
topConcern: A copy of the fight simulator's player on the room clock; simulator changes do not reach it.

title: PvP engagement record, directional
oneLine: Per pair, who struck whom within 10 s, deciding which players area moves may hit.
topConcern: At 2048 live pairs the whole map is cleared, forgetting real engagements until the next blow.

title: A player's PvP statuses and holds
oneLine: Time-gated statuses and holds on a PvP target: element statuses, daze/stuck immunity, stagger, guard break, gust, kill-heal ledger.
topConcern: Daze is written by three files with copied logic; the kill-heal ledger survives the attacker's death and refunds an older life's damage.

title: Paid special window
oneLine: A charged swipe opens three special claims for 3.5 s; outside it a special claim rolls as ordinary.
topConcern: A reconnect inside the window forgets it, so a paid special lands as an ordinary hit.

title: No Man's Land skulls (red / white with hit-back rights)
oneLine: Red and white skulls with per-attacker hit-back rights, counted down in online time, stored in nml_state.
topConcern: NML live flags change the worker's rule at once, but phones learn their caps only at the next join, so they disagree meanwhile.

title: No Man's Land kill attribution and the death's loss
oneLine: The last NML blow within 5 s makes a death an NML kill; the killer takes bag, gold and spares.
topConcern: Each loot credit is fire-and-forget; a restart after the victim's save loses that piece for both, deliberately never a duplicate.

title: No Man's Land lock after a red skull's death
oneLine: A red skull killed by their victim is locked out from attacking them for 30 minutes, stored.
topConcern: An older worker's save drops the lock field during a rollback, so locks lapse early; acknowledged.

title: Dungeon instance (start → waves → boss → done → cleaned)
oneLine: A private run whose membership is standing in its zone; swept when empty, done after its boss.
topConcern: Start and party pull never check a duel or arena match, so a dueller is taken into a private zone and the duel becomes unwinnable.

title: Dungeon boss ability cycle
oneLine: A boss's cast cycle: ready, one-second telegraph, execute, cooldown; charges, capped summons and an enrage ramp.

title: A run's XP ledger and the boss's chest
oneLine: Fight XP noted per weapon in a dungeon zone, paid flat into those skills, with the chest, at the clear.
topConcern: A reconnect mid-run forgets the ledger, so the clear's XP goes to the weapon in hand.

title: On-chain score checkpoint
oneLine: A level milestone queues a preflight, nonce read, send and receipt wait, then stores chain_score; failures retry next level-up.
topConcern: rpcCall's fetch has no timeout, so one hung RPC blocks the room-wide send queue and that player's lane until a restart.

title: Event cape ticket and cape
oneLine: A contest ticket drops against a cached ledger, is redeemed for a cape, then worn or taken off.
topConcern: Before the ledger warms after a restart, a winner's cape is stripped from the relayed look.

title: Event contest switch
oneLine: Whether the cape contest runs: a source constant, a durable stop flag and rate, and a one-shot start clear.
topConcern: The contest's phase spans source, durable flags and a stored id; its history records silent vetoes nobody could see.

title: PvP consent pair shared by duels, arena matches and threats
oneLine: Pair key to expiry: the damage gate's 'you two may fight', written and cleared by duels, arena and threats.
topConcern: One keyspace for three owners: a duel's resolve deletes a threat consent between the same pair; dormant while open PvP is off.

title: Event placement filter
oneLine: Which phone hears each tick event: placed events by distance or zone, stateful ones kept room-wide by allowlist.
topConcern: Correct only against a 2026-10-13 client audit; a client handler keeping state from a placed type would desync far phones.

title: Arena house prize budget
oneLine: A per-clock-hour house prize counter, loaded once per room life and saved before the champion is paid.
topConcern: A failed fire-and-forget save keeps memory right but a later restart restores the older total, adding budget back.
